basis: Defining skin changes, immunodeficiency and gonadal failure; visual loss/cataracts 80-99%. Cap omits neurologic, skeletal, dental, hepatic and cardiac involvement.

decisions.neurologic: none: cognitive impairment and thalamic abnormalities at 80-99% qualify, but the four-organ cap prioritizes defining skin, immune and endocrine disease plus progressive visual loss.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: hypergonadotropic hypogonadism and gonadal hormone deficiency occur in 80-99%, supporting endocrine gland failure.

basis: Allelic umbrella principally encompassing tubulointerstitial kidney disease and antibody deficiency; neutropenia is an alternative presentation without evidence of predominance.

decisions.haematologic: none: congenital neutropenia is an alternative allelic presentation; the record does not establish that it applies to most patients across this umbrella.

basis: Defined by tongue pain or burning; the tongue is gastrointestinal. A neurological pain classification alone does not establish intrinsic nerve disease.

decisions.neurologic: none: tongue pain alone, despite the neurological pain parent, does not establish a disease of the nervous system.

basis: ALPL deficiency defines a metabolic mineralization disorder of bones and teeth; defective dental cementum and premature tooth loss are characteristic diagnostic manifestations.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: defective tooth mineralization/cementum and premature tooth loss are defining dental manifestations of hypophosphatasia; teeth belong to gastrointestinal.

basis: Defining neurodegenerative parkinsonism/dementia; myopathic EMG abnormalities occur in 30-79%, supporting muscle involvement. Gaze and autonomic abnormalities reflect neural disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: explicitly myopathic EMG abnormalities at 30-79% support intrinsic muscle involvement beyond neurologically mediated rigidity or weakness.

basis: Glycosylation defect with cerebellar disease; coagulation dysfunction ~80-90%, hepatic disease ~60%. Cap omits ocular findings (80-99%), renal cysts (11/16) and skeletal disease.

decisions.haematologic: involved: glycosylation-related coagulation factor deficiencies affect approximately 80-90% and impair coagulation.
decisions.ocular: none: strabismus at 80-99% supports involvement, but the cap prioritizes coagulation dysfunction and hepatic injury alongside metabolic and neurologic disease.

basis: Neurodevelopmental and persistent skin abnormalities define the syndrome; exotropia occurs in 4/4. Hypermobility and weakness in 2/4 do not establish intrinsic muscle or joint damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: hypermobility and weakness each occur in 2/4, but joint injury, functional joint impairment or intrinsic myopathy is not established.

basis: Ischemic injury directly affects the colon; altered perfusion need not involve intrinsic vessel disease. Secondary ischemic inflammation does not establish an immune mechanism.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: colonic ischemia can result from systemic hypoperfusion without intrinsic vascular injury; the vascular parent does not establish vessel disease across the concept.

basis: Inherited susceptibility to CLL identifies a future disease risk; it does not establish leukemia, blood-cell dysfunction or existing damage on any organ axis.

decisions.haematologic: none: susceptibility to a blood malignancy is a later risk, not established blood-cell or marrow disease.

basis: Inherited mitochondrial metabolic defect; encephalopathy/regression occurs in 30-79%, pulmonary arterial hypertension in 7/10. Respiratory failure alone does not establish intrinsic lung damage.

decisions.neurologic: involved: encephalopathy and developmental regression occur in 30-79%, with leukoencephalopathy supporting direct CNS injury; the defining disease is a mitochondrial metabolic defect.
